Ability to influence quality outcomes through strong collaboration, clear communication, and pragmatic decision-making. Experience making architecture-level automation decisions in complex environments. Strong system-thinking mindset with the ability to balance speed, quality, and risk. Strong background in Agile, DevOps, and continuous testing practices. Experience supporting cloud-native, microservices, and API-driven systems. Preferred Qualifications Experience in enterprise-scale or regulated environments. Exposure to CIAM, security testing, or identity-centric platforms. Prior experience driving quality transformation or modernization initiatives. Familiarity with observability, analytics, and test intelligence platforms.
